reasoning_notes: High cancel_rate (>0.6) + multiple prior fraud flags → strong fraud signal (predict 1).
Normal student ordering pattern: ~5-15 orders/month, low cancel rate, device token → predict 0.
No device token + very high cancel rate with large orders → suspicious pattern.
fraud_flagged_count > 0 is the strongest individual predictor.
avg_amount: typical campus meal ₹50-200 (in rupees in DB); very high amounts (>1000) are anomalous.
Threshold for classification: model outputs probability; we compare against 0.5 threshold.
predicted_class rather than probability is used — so each case expects 0 or 1.

cases.description: Normal student — regular ordering, device token, no fraud history
cases.note: Clean pattern — should predict NOT fraud (0)

cases.description: Suspicious user — high cancel rate, no device token, prior fraud flags
cases.note: Strong fraud signal — should predict FRAUD (1)

cases.description: Faculty member — moderate orders, low cancel, no fraud history
cases.note: Clean pattern — should predict NOT fraud (0)

cases.description: Extreme cancel rate, zero legitimate orders completed, anomalous amounts
cases.note: Very strong fraud signal — should predict FRAUD (1)

cases.description: New user — few orders, no cancellations, device token present
cases.note: Clean new user — should predict NOT fraud (0)

cases.description: Borderline: moderate cancel rate, no device token, no prior flags
cases.note: Borderline but no fraud flags — most likely NOT fraud (0)

cases.description: Heavy user with 1 prior fraud flag and elevated cancel rate
cases.note: 1 prior fraud flag + elevated cancel — should predict FRAUD (1)

cases.description: Inactive user — very few orders, single cancellation
cases.note: 100% cancel but only 1 order — likely innocent; no fraud history (0)
